 """py.test tests for addbook"""
+import pytest
 import web
 from .. import addbook
 from openlibrary import accounts
 from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'author_fields',
+    [{}, {'author_key': ['OL1A']}, {'author_name': ['An Author']}],
+)
+def test_make_work_without_complete_author_fields(author_fields):
+    doc = {'title': 'A Work', **author_fields}
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert isinstance(work, web.Storage)
+    assert all(work[field] == value for field, value in doc.items())
+    assert work.authors == []
+    assert work.cover_url == '/images/icons/avatar_book-sm.png'
+    assert work.ia == []
+    assert work.first_publish_year is None
+
+
+def test_make_work_preserves_metadata_and_creates_authors(monkeypatch):
+    author = object()
+    calls = []
+
+    def new(key, data):
+        calls.append((key, data))
+        return author
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx, 'site', web.storage(new=new), raising=False)
+    doc = {
+        'title': 'A Work',
+        'author_key': ['OL1A'],
+        'author_name': ['An Author'],
+        'cover_url': '/custom-cover.png',
+        'ia': ['archive-id'],
+        'first_publish_year': 2000,
+    }
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert work.authors == [author]
+    assert calls == [
+        (
+            '/authors/OL1A',
+            {'key': '/authors/OL1A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'An Author'},
+        )
+    ]
+    assert work.cover_url == '/custom-cover.png'
+    assert work.ia == ['archive-id']
+    assert work.first_publish_year == 2000
+    assert work.title == 'A Work'
+
+
